source: GtRNAdb (UCSC Lowe Lab), Mus musculus tRNA gene set
build: tRNAscan-SE 2.0 nuclear tRNA gene set from mm39-tRNAs.fa; SeC (selenocysteine, anticodon TCA) and suppressor (Sup, anticodons TCA/TTA) tRNAs excluded as non-sense decoders; genes counted per anticodon (initiator + elongator Met merged at CAT). Independently re-counted from a sha256-pinned FASTA with zero mismatches (407 predicted loci minus 1 SeC minus 2 Sup = 404 sense tRNA genes).
genome: GRCm39 / mm39 (nuclear only; no mitochondrial tRNAs)
note: Real tRNA gene copy numbers by anticodon. tAI relative adaptiveness is derived via the dos Reis et al. (2004) wobble model (optimised s-values, sking=0 eukaryota) as in the tai R package; see bt4.biomodels.codon.tai. Reproducible from this file's SHA-256. Source database: GtRNAdb (Chan & Lowe, Nucleic Acids Res 2016, doi:10.1093/nar/gkv1309), predictions by tRNAscan-SE 2.0 (Chan et al. 2021, doi:10.1093/nar/gkab688). GtRNAdb states no explicit data license: citation-gated academic use, NOT a CC/public-domain grant.
